div.span:
• Wire Tap Backpressure Isolation: Wire Tap buffer capacity K bounds maximum memory. Buffer saturation drops tap events, preserving primary SLA.
• Dynamic Detour Hot-Swapping: Control Bus broadcasts reconfiguration events to all live proxy instances without requiring service restarts or redeployments.
• DLQ Redrive Safety: Poison pills must be quarantined or remediated before redrive to prevent recurring crash loops. Redrive rate must not exceed 10% of channel capacity.
